title: Claims Reference: Age and Duration Addition to Death Benefit Valuation Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An addition to the death benefit valuation interest of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract depends on the owner's age at death and on how long the contract had been held.

**Rule.** The valuation age addition is **0.10% (0.001)** where the owner was aged **80** or more at death and had held the contract for at least **2** whole years at death, **0.05% (0.0005)** where the owner was under 80 at death and had held the contract for at least 2 whole years, and nothing otherwise. The addition is added to each rate at which the death benefit valuation interest is worked. Ages and years held are whole years counted to the date of death; years held run from the issue date.

| Age at death | Whole years held at death | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 80 or more | 2 or more | 0.10% |
| Under 80 | 2 or more | 0.05% |
| Any | Under 2 | Nothing |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** Issue date 10 May 2023: a death on 9 May 2025 is 1 whole year held (nothing); a death on 10 May 2025 is 2 whole years held. An owner aged 79 at death with 5 years held: 0.05%; aged 80: 0.10%.
